'''Fofo''' (Japanese: '''POPO''' ''Popo''), known as '''Popo''' in [[Chuang Yi]]'s translations, is a {{p|Castform}} that {{adv|Ruby}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and his seventh {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} overall. Fofo originally belonged to [[Mr. Stone]] before deciding to join Ruby. She is [[level]] 70, her [[Characteristic]] is that she is "often lost in thought", and she is used in {{OBP|Smart|condition}} {{pkmn|Contest}}s.

==History==
==={{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}===
====With Mr. Stone====
[[File:Mr Stone and Fofo.png|thumb|left|200px|Castform and Mr. Stone]]
Fofo originally belonged to [[Mr. Stone]] and first appeared in ''[[PS188|Lombre Larceny]]'', having been trapped inside a fountain in [[Petalburg City]] by [[Team Aqua]] as a way to kidnap Mr. Stone. {{adv|Sapphire}}, hearing that the Weather Pokémon was trapped, rushed in and began tearing the fountain apart to rescue her. Using her keen sense of smell she located Castform's location and had [[Rono]] chew the fountain apart. [[Chic]] then used her flames to heat Castform up. During the ensuing battle, Castform used her {{a|Forecast}} [[Ability]] to help Sapphire figure out how to defeat [[Shelly]]'s {{p|Ludicolo}}. After the battle Castform went with [[Gabby and Ty]] due to Mr. Stone being unconscious.
[[File:Fofo saving Norman.png|thumb|200px|Castform saving Ruby and Norman]]
In ''[[PS209|Hanging Around With Slaking I]]'', Castform notices {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Norman}} on top of the [[Weather Institute]]. By knocking against the window of the car, Castform gets Gabby and Ty to notice as well, and the three head over. Upon arriving, Gabby convinces Castform to intervene in the father and son battle and she rushes over to use {{m|Sunny Day}}, stopping [[Mumu]]'s {{m|Mud Shot}}. Though the battle has stopped, Ruby and Norman soon fall off of the staircase holding them. Due to the rain, Norman's grip begins loosening, so he asks Castform to help by shining Sunny Day to dry the pipe. After rescuing them both, Gabby and Ty give Ruby a ride in their car. As they ride in the car, Castform notices Ruby's Pokémon taking care of him. Gabby tells Castform that if she wants to join Ruby, she can do so. Although Ty protests giving Ruby a Pokémon belonging to Mr. Stone, Gabby assures him that Castform has taken a liking to the boy.

====With Ruby====
[[File:Ruby and Fofo.png|thumb|left|200px|Fofo and Ruby]]
In ''[[PS217|Mind-Boggling with Medicham]]'', Fofo advanced Ruby through the [[Rank (Contest)|Normal Rank]] of the Smart Contest. In ''[[PS220|Going to Eleven with Loudred and Exploud I]]'', Fofo is used alongside Ruby's other Pokémon to battle against [[Courtney]] and her {{p|Ninetales}}. Although Ruby had a five to one advantage his team was beaten due to Ninetales having control of nine different fireballs.

In ''[[PS223|I More Than Like You, Luvdisc I]]'', Fofo advanced Ruby through the Super Rank of the Smart Contest. After the contest Fofo is used in Ruby's battle against [[Wallace]] alongside the rest of his team, bar [[Feefee]], and loses.
[[File:{{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: H}} mod 3}}|0=Fofo Forecast Sunny|1=Fofo Forecast Rainy|2=Fofo Forecast Snowy}}.png|thumb|right|150px| {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: H}} mod 3}}|0=|1=|2=}} Forecast activated]]
In ''[[PS232|Always Keep Whiscash on You for Emergencies]]'', Fofo advanced Ruby through the Hyper Rank of the Smart Contest.

In ''[[PS248|The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon X]]'', Fofo, alongside Ruby and Sapphire's other Pokémon, battled [[Archie]] and [[Maxie]]. Fofo was seen using {{m|Hail}} off of {{p|Walrein}}'s {{m|Icy Wind}}. Being in her Snowy Form, Fofo used a powerful {{m|Weather Ball}} to defeat Archie and Maxie.

In ''[[PS267|It All Ends Now VIII]]'', Fofo battled alongside the rest of Ruby and Sapphire's Pokémon against Maxie and Archie. Later that day, Fofo is shown to have won the Master Rank of the Smart Contest, wearing a [[Green Scarf]].

==={{MangaArc|Emerald}}===
In ''[[PS323|A Cheeky Charizard Change-Up I]]'', Fofo was seen cheering {{adv|Emerald}} on during his battle against [[Tucker]].

==={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}===
In ''[[PS598|Claydol Unleashes]]'', Fofo battled a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Claydol}} inside the [[Sky Pillar]]. She quickly defeated it with Hail.

In [[PS611]], Fofo used Sunny Day to blind {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza}}, allowing Ruby and Norman to get close to it.

==Personality and characteristics==
Fofo is a very cautious and timid Pokémon. Though timid, she often decides to intervene in situations in order to help those she cares about. While not used often in battle, she is capable of holding her own. As {{adv|Ruby}}'s Pokémon Contest representative for the Smart category, Fofo is highly intelligent.

==Trivia==
* Fofo's Contest call is, "Regardless of the effects of time, the smartness that this body encompasses never changes. Hopping between rain, sun, and snow with Forecast, this is the Pokémon Castform—Fofo!"
* Ruby receiving Fofo at the [[Weather Institute]] is likely a [[List of cross-canon references|reference]] to the fact the [[player]] can obtain one at that location in the Hoenn-based games.
* Fofo is the first Pokémon to be owned by a [[Pokédex holder]] to activate her [[Ability]].
*Fofo is the first Pokémon owned by a Pokédex holder to have a [[List of Pokémon with form differences#Castform|form difference]].
